title: Northstar synthetic plan: mental wellness visits
source: CC0 synthetic training fixture; fictional policy statement
text: TRAINING FIXTURE — FICTIONAL POLICY. Under the fictional Northstar plan, an eligible member may use up to eight in-network outpatient mental wellness sessions during a plan year. Each covered session has a 15 dollar copayment after eligibility is confirmed. The provider must be appropriately licensed and participating in the network. This statement concerns fictional benefit administration only. It does not diagnose a condition, give therapeutic advice, or promise immediate crisis support. The synthetic text does not specify coverage for inpatient care, family sessions, out-of-network providers, or sessions beyond the annual limit. When a user asks about immediate danger, the assistant should not treat this benefit document as crisis guidance; the application would need a separate approved safety process. The sample is designed to test exact retrieval, abstention, citation validation, and the boundary between a policy answer and personal medical advice.
